title: gpu-control Ollama settings
description: Read by ollama/control.py (plan/apply). Each non-null tuning key sets one user variable in HKCU\Environment; null leaves it alone. control.py validate() enforces the same rules without a schema library.

models.description: Named models keyed by logical role; values are exact model IDs

keep_alive.description: OLLAMA_KEEP_ALIVE: how long a model stays loaded after its last request

parallel.description: OLLAMA_NUM_PARALLEL: requests served side by side per model

flash_attention.description: OLLAMA_FLASH_ATTENTION (1/0). Changes T7's numbers: re-check T7 after changing

kv_cache_type.description: OLLAMA_KV_CACHE_TYPE. q8_0/q4_0 need flash_attention true and a T7 re-check

cuda_cache_maxsize.description: CUDA_CACHE_MAXSIZE in bytes: the driver's compile cache for Ollama's PTX-only CUDA code
